records.text: After the White House Military Office's attempt to rescind the email failed or came too late, it sent multiple emails ordering recipients to delete it and brought in more IT staff.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 7FS1tUeSfdE)

appearances.snippet: The, I guess you could say the White House military office panicked and they attempted to rescind the email. ... But for some reason that did not work or it worked too late. I don't know what the issue is that but it did not resolve the issue. ... They then panicked even further, I am told, and sent out multiple emails instructing the people that were on that email that they absolutely had to delete it. ... And then they brought in more IT to get involved to deal with this blunder.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes the deletion and added IT claims to an anonymous source and supplies no original emails or identified witnesses. Current reporting merely repeats the allegation; no authenticated record or independent confirmation was found.
